exact_intake_statement: For a RWRE satisfying (E) and (IID) and any direction l, is P_0[A_l] in {0,1}, where A_l is the event of transience in direction l? Known for d = 1 and d = 2 (Zerner-Merkl).
primary_statement_locator: Drewitz and Ramirez, Definition 2.13 (PDF p.19), Definition 2.3 (PDF p.6), Open question 3.2 (PDF p.41)
primary_assumptions: Nearest-neighbor RWRE on Z^d, iid full transition rows, strictly positive probabilities for all 2d allowed steps almost surely; A_l={X_n dot l -> +infinity}; annealed P_0; each fixed unit direction l; d>=3 is the previously unresolved dimension.
